intro: Family-owned paintless dent repair in San Antonio. We work out door dings, creases and hail damage from behind the panel, so your original paint stays.
servicesIntro: From a single door ding to a full hail storm.

services.name: Door Ding & Dent Repair
services.text: Parking-lot dings, minor collisions and everyday impacts, worked out of the panel.

services.name: Hail Damage Repair
services.text: Small to medium dents across the vehicle after a storm, reversed to pre-storm condition.

services.name: Large Dent & Crease Repair
services.text: Bigger dents and creases, as long as the paint has not cracked, keep their original contour and finish.

why.name: Original paint stays
why.text: No repainting means the factory finish and the resale value stay with the car.

why.name: Faster and cheaper than a body shop
why.text: No filling, sanding or painting. Skilled technicians massage the dents out with specialized tools.

why.name: Lifetime guarantee
why.text: Every repair comes with a 100% satisfaction guarantee and a lifetime warranty, from a family-owned team with over four decades in auto hail repair.

howTitle: Back to like new in three steps.

steps.name: Send the details
steps.text: Call, or use the form with your year, make, model and photos of the damage.

steps.name: Get an evaluation
steps.text: Bring the vehicle in and we look at the hail damage, dings or film options.

steps.name: Drive it smooth
steps.text: We work the dents out and hand the vehicle back.
